items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And it was Chick Webb's band. ... Yeah, Lionel Hampton and Chick Webb. ... Certainly not Christopher Columbus. Chick Webb, I guess, is associated with both of those songs, don't you think? Yes.

ctx.x: Do you remember what year this was?

It had to be 1932. In fact, I have an autographed book with Ella's autograph in it, and she doesn't even know if she signed it. But I was waiting tables during the affair. And all of a sudden I heard this voice and I knew it was Ella Fitzgerald. I didn't wait tables the rest of the night. I went and sat right in front of the bad. And I think this was one of the first tours that Ella was out on. This was right after she first got started. And it was Chick Webb's band.
